difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: if f : X -> Y is locally of finite type then its diagonal Delta is locally of finite presentation, and if f is quasi-separated and locally of finite type then Delta is of finite presentation (source lines 5846-5853). The proof views Delta as a morphism over X through the second projection, notes that X is of finite presentation over X and that X x_Y X is of finite type over X by base change, and applies the permanence statement for local finite presentation; the second statement then follows from the first, the definitions, and separatedness of the diagonal.
